SU.VOP.route_gather.engine: ot_hbm_su_indexed_scalar (static SU MDESC indexed-scalar engine; the static SU arith/programme path refuses indexed records: tools/hbm_static/su_arith_lower.py 'MDESC_indexed_scalar_runtime_address_calendar')
SU.VOP.route_gather.rtl_new: ot_hbm_su_indexed_scalar_rows (additive successor; rows=1 is edge-for-edge the single-row engine, done at phase 34)
SU.VOP.route_gather.vehicle: 32 ot_vms_bank_static banks / 96 ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256 macros + 3-flop return / 4-flop write relay (as tb_indexed_scalar)
SU.VOP.route_gather.vs_model: II matches (1); c1 36 < model 60 (model is the SU nv1 + depth-55 price)
SU.VOP.route_gather.exact: PASS: 24 records (canonical route.gather P1/P6 at 4,096-word position stride, packed 1-word stride with word-masked writes in shared sectors, SID-crossing strides, R=1..8 sweep, 12 random), 824 word checks, every record of R rows on one fixed edge count
SU.VOP.route_gather.schedule: row r: I read on busy phase r, A read r+13, O write r+26; index and score reads never share an edge for R <= 13 (one RG0 read + one WG0 write an edge, the compiler's reserved slots)

ARGMAX.LOCAL.engine: ot_hbm_argmax_static (VM mode, as specialised by the die master ot_hbm_argmax_static_sw_vm); closed engine ot_hgi_argmax18_m unchanged
ARGMAX.LOCAL.rtl_new: ot_hbm_argmax_static_rows (additive successor, VM records only like the die's _sw_vm; rows=1 edge-for-edge mode 0)
ARGMAX.LOCAL.vehicle: actual SW VM slice hfd_hgi_vms_static_SW (static hub, 8 banks, 24 SRAMs) via the 3-owner IDX read-group share and the argmax record client; bench = tb_argmax_static with the current v15/v16 slice ABI (NC 3, RG 5, WG 2: packet write slot WG+2 = 4, DMA dq slot WG+4 = 6)
ARGMAX.LOCAL.vs_model: II 169 >> model 6: on this die ARGMAX reads logits from VM ONE SECTOR (8 FP32) AN EDGE into the LP-8 closed engine (1,347 / 8 = 169 sectors a row); the model's '1,347-row shard / 256 lanes' assumes a 256-lane stream. c1 211 > 142.7 (the VM-read form, H-NETLIST note '+~190 edges vs the stream form'). Rows still save the fixed part: 6 x 211 = 1,266 -> 1,056 (-210 edges a step).
ARGMAX.LOCAL.exact: PASS on 3 seeds (32 records each: DS n=1,347 P1/P6 aligned + packed-unaligned main/mirror, 24 random R=1..8 incl. NaN/special values, 4 illegal: n=0, rows=0, rows>1 & n<33, A rows crossing the SID); value + id words checked in the actual VM
ARGMAX.LOCAL.constraint: rows > 1 needs n >= 33 (ns >= 5): row r's two writes use record-client tag slots {r[0], 0/1}; a slot is reused two rows later >= 10 edges after its last use (hub releases at W+1+9)

added_state.flops_delta_vs_vm_only_engine: ~+130 (yosys: rows 1,455 flops vs 2,104 for ot_hbm_argmax_static incl. 781 STREAM-path flops the VM-only die master does not need)

DMA.KVWB_DS.engine: ot_hgi_dma_back_static (per-quadrant VM->HBM store engine, unchanged; the die's ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks is its successor with the same move227 ABI)
DMA.KVWB_DS.form: ONE move227 with m = P rows (n 512 words, VM row stride = the position-copy stride, dense HBM stride n*4 = 2,048 B into P consecutive window-ring slots); ABI: m <= 128 chunks/lane, n % 64 == 0, VM stride >= n, HBM stride == n*4. A ring wrap inside the P rows splits into two moves (the engine faults on a move while busy: the second move issues after the first's first_drain + chunks + 1).
DMA.KVWB_DS.vehicle: 8 ot_vms_bank_static banks / 24 VM macros + 8 ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 landing macros
DMA.KVWB_DS.vs_model: II 8 > model 2: the engine moves one 64-word chunk (256 B) an edge per quadrant, so a 2,048 B row costs 8 edges; the model's II = c1 - first_access assumed the row at full die HBM bandwidth
DMA.KVWB_DS.exact: PASS: every WB beat's HBM sector, lane, payload and fixed edge (drain_at + 2 + chunk) checked for R = 1, 2, 6, 8 (n 512, VM stride 1,024)

DMA.LOAD.position_addressed.reason: no static HBM->VM DMA.LOAD record engine is bound in tools/hbm_die_v15/v16_specs (the HBM service VM delivery ot_hbm_svc_static_vm_delivery_split lanes are the load path; per-row indexed/dyn_sel addresses = one service read a row). Open item for the service/H-NETLIST owner.

KVWB II 8 vs model 2: price DMA.KVWB_DS rows at n*4 / 256 B a quadrant edge (8 for n 512) unless the rows are split across quadrant engines.
